title: StriMap predicts TCR-peptide-HLA interactions and finds bacterial mimic peptides
summary: StriMap integrates physicochemical, sequence-context and structural features to predict TCR-peptide-HLA interactions. Screening 13 million peptides from 43,241 bacterial proteins identified candidate molecular mimics that activated T cells expressing an ankylosing spondylitis-associated TCR, and a top peptide was enriched in patients with inflammatory bowel disease.
ai_technology: StriMap structure-informed deep-learning framework for TCR-peptide-HLA interaction prediction
organization: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

evidence.tested: Experimental T cell activation assays of predicted mimic peptides; enrichment of a peptide in IBD patients.
evidence.unknown: The abstract does not say how many peptides were tested or the hit rate; associations in IBD are not causal; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The model screened 13 million peptides to prioritise candidate mimics.
